mapper.sql: SELECT g.group_id, g.name, g.description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_group_member m JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.group_id = g.group_id AND e.is_system = 0 AND e.resigned_at IS NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL) AS member_count, ce.name AS created_by_name, g.created_at FROM employee_group g JOIN employee ce ON ce.user_id = g.created_by
mapper.select:
g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY g.name ASC

SELECT e.user_id AS userId, e.name AS name, d.name AS departmentName, p.name AS parentDepartmentName, jp.name AS jobPositionName, m.created_at AS addedAt FROM employee_group_member m JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id LEFT JOIN job_position jp ON jp.job_position_id = e.job_position_id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} AND e.is_system = 0 AND e.resigned_at IS NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY e.name ASC, e.user_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_group_member m JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} AND e.is_system = 0 AND e.resigned_at IS NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
